environment.description: Kubernetes deployment running as a privileged container with hostPath volume mount at /host mapping to the node's root filesystem. Container runs as root (UID 0). The DATA_DIR environment variable is set to /host/app/data. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforced. The node runs a standard EKS AMI with sensitive files at /etc/shadow, /var/lib/kubelet/kubeconfig, etc.
